**Breaking: Major Solo Crash on SR 51 North Traps Occupant, Snarls Traffic**

NORTH SACRAMENTO – A severe single-vehicle collision at 2:56 PM today on northbound State Route 51, just north of Fulton Avenue, has left at least one person trapped and is causing significant traffic disruptions.

An orange Pontiac Vibe reportedly lost control, flipped off the roadway into a ditch, and violently collided with an electrical pole and a chain-link fence. Witnesses described the vehicle as "almost split in two" due to the catastrophic impact.

Emergency crews, including the fire department, are on scene actively working to extricate a trapped occupant from the wreckage. The crash has also knocked down three poles and severely damaged 30 feet of chain-link fencing.

Traffic is significantly impacted, with the slow lane and potentially additional lanes blocked. A tow truck has been requested to assist with clearing the scene. Several individuals stopped to offer assistance immediately after the crash.

**Breaking News: Westbound I-10 Gridlocked After Fiery Collision in Baldwin Park**

BALDWIN PARK, CA – A major traffic collision brought westbound Interstate 10 to a standstill just west of Kellogg Drive around 2:02 PM today. A pickup truck reportedly slammed into a semi-truck parked on the right shoulder, with initial reports indicating the pickup was on fire. Good Samaritans were on scene attempting to free the pickup from under the semi.

The incident prompted an immediate traffic alert, closing all westbound lanes for approximately one hour and causing severe delays. While fire department officials later confirmed no active fire, the extensive cleanup and response effort heavily impacted the evening commute. Lanes, including the High Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) and far-left lanes, have since reopened.
